policy.equity_basis: every observed bar close, including open P&L and charged costs
policy.selection: assess every frozen Narrow candidate independently; no reselection

warnings: Bar spacing varies. Gaps are preserved; no bars are filled or removed.
dataset.name: SYNTHETIC frozen OOS

strategy.description: Enter long at the close of N adjacent observed green bars while flat. Hold for elapsed UTC minutes, exit at the first available close at or after the deadline, and close remaining exposure at end of data. No pyramiding.

parameters.name: green_bar_count
parameters.description: Consecutive observed bars with Close > Open required while flat.

parameters.name: hold_minutes
parameters.description: Elapsed UTC minutes from the actual entry time to the target exit.

parameters.name: contracts
parameters.description: Fixed contract quantity requested for each long entry.

plan.percentage_basis: chronological whole trading dates; floor(IS% × date count)

oos_policy.equity_basis: every observed bar close, including open P&L and charged costs
oos_policy.selection: assess every frozen Narrow candidate independently; no reselection

policy.daily_equity_basis: last observed source-local bar close per calendar date, including open P&L
policy.uncertainty_method: Bartlett HAC one-sided normal lower bound
policy.multiple_search_correction: Bonferroni over all attempted Broad and Narrow trials, including failed/incomplete jobs
policy.plateau_directions: nearest tested lower/higher value on each varied ordered-numeric axis; other parameters unchanged
policy.boundary_handling: use available neighbors; label one-sided assessments
policy.resolution: tested grid spacing only; no claim about smaller untested changes
